Name: Dynamic Locked Doors
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=5][center][b]Dynamic Locked Doors[/b][/center]
[/size][size=3]Inspired by minervamaga's sadly defunct [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/605843-summer-hours]Summer Hours[/url], [/size][size=3]this mod allows you to configure what time people will unlock their buildings. It affects both business and residential buildings, but does not affect interior doors that require two hearts with a particular NPC and does not affect shop hours.

[/size][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][size=3]:

To install DLD, simply extract the "[CP] Dynamic Locked Doors" folder and drop it into your Mods folder.


[/size][size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size][size=3]:

DLD has one configuration setting, TimeOptions. The options for this setting are:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]AlwaysOpen[/b]: Buildings will be open all day long from 6 AM to 2 AM.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]OneHourEarlier[/b]: Buildings will open one hour earlier than their default time and close at their regular time.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]EarlySummer[/b]: In summer, buildings will open one hour earlier and close one hour later.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]FriendsWelcome[/b]: If you have 4 to 7 hearts with an adult member of the household, the building will be open one hour earlier and close one hour later. If you have 8 or higher hearts with an adult member of the household, the building will be open all day long from 6 AM to 2 AM. This is the default setting for the mod.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]EarlySummerFriendsWelcome[/b]: This option combines all of the features of [size=3][b]EarlySummer[/b][/size] and [size=3][b]FriendsWelcome[/b][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][b]NoChange: [/b]If selected, this option will restore the default building opening hours.[/size][/size]
[/list]

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]:

[size=3]This mod only affects vanilla locations and will not affect any mod-added buildings either in Pelican Town or in mod-added locations. Any mods that move the location of a vanilla building will be incompatible. [b]This mod is untested with SVE but is likely semi-incompatible and I will not add compatibility[/b]. Any comments asking about SVE compatibility will be deleted.[/size]
